notes: All figures transcribed from the Dunkin' Nutrition Guide PDF ("last updated 09-21-2026") linked as "Get Nutrition PDF" from https://www.dunkindonuts.com/nutrition/. Drinks are the Medium size with the guide's listed milk/sweetener; food is one unit as sold. Munchkins are per donut hole.

Dunkin' publishes finished-drink variants (e.g. Hot Coffee, Hot Coffee with Cream, Hot Coffee with Cream and Sugar) rather than per-add-in nutrition, so the cream, sugar, milk, swirl and cold-foam components here are derived by subtracting one published medium drink from another (see each component's "derived"). Swirl flavors and sweeteners are the medium-size default pumps. Unsweetened flavor shots are not in the guide and are omitted.

Sandwich components (egg and cheese filling, bacon, sausage, turkey sausage) are likewise derived by subtracting published sandwiches on the same bread. Sausage, Egg and Cheese on Croissant is not a row in this guide; it is the only item whose macros are built rather than published.

Omitted because the guide publishes them only as regional/limited-time Halloween items, or not at all: Frozen Coffee (no row in this guide), Hot Caramel Craze/other signature lattes beyond Caramel Craze and Cocoa Mocha, Dunkin’ Energy, Daydream/protein refreshers, kolaches, kosher items.
